title: About My Flight Tracker
subtitle: Personal flight data visualization made simple and beautiful
what_is_this_p1: This Flight Data Visualizer is a personal project that transforms raw flight history into beautiful, interactive visualizations.
what_is_this_p2: Whether you're an aviation enthusiast, frequent traveler, or data visualization lover, this tool helps you explore and understand your travel patterns in ways you've never seen before.
developer_p1: Hi! I'm Federico Tartarini, a passionate developer who loves creating tools that make data beautiful and accessible. With expertise in both backend data processing and frontend visualization, I enjoy building applications that solve real problems while delivering great user experiences.
developer_p2: This project combines my interests in aviation, data science, and web development. I believe in open-source software and sharing knowledge with the developer community.
features_1: Interactive globe visualization of flight routes
features_4: Responsive design for desktop and mobile
support_text_p1: If you find this project useful or interesting, there are several ways to show support and help it grow:
support_text_p2: Your support helps me dedicate more time to improving this project, adding new features, and maintaining the codebase. Every contribution, no matter how small, is greatly appreciated!
contribute_p1: Contributions are welcome! If you want to add features, fix bugs, or improve documentation, please visit the project repository on GitHub.
contribute_link_fork: Fork the repository and submit a pull request
contribute_link_issues: Report bugs or request features via GitHub Issues
open_source_p1: This project is open source and welcomes contributions from the community. Whether you're interested in adding features, fixing bugs, improving documentation, or just sharing feedback, your involvement helps make this tool better for everyone.
open_source_p2: Built with ❤️ using React, Vite, Mantine UI, Python, and lots of coffee.
